📦 **meadow-battle-icons `e4fae3a`** — feat(ui): replace battle crew and cannon emoji with refined pixel icons

Use one embedded PNG registry for the female sailor, cannon, explosive shell
and chain shot. Fleet counters, firing controls, ship information, ammo,
help and key binding hints share these sources in the standalone build.
Keep population and recruitment meanings separate from battle crew counts.

Validated actual combat UI at1280x720 and390x844, both ammo transitions,
all9 help icons, build ownership/layer gates and834758 AST nodes.
srccheck covers196 sources and44 unchanged ship assets.
Generation prompts, hashes and screenshots live in docs/evidence/battle-pixel-icons.
